Both serve restaurant diners, but Texas Roadhouse focuses on casual table-service dining rather than quick-service burgers.
notes_matthew: Texas Roadhouse is a mass market casual dining chain with 816 units, and its 10-K names quick service and fast casual chains as competitors. Different format from Wendy's but the same business selling meals to the same consumers.
judge_reason: Both serve prepared meals to restaurant consumers, but Wendy’s emphasizes burgers, breakfast and drive-thru/delivery, while Texas Roadhouse emphasizes steaks, ribs and sides. Shared diners and restaurant meal sales support adjacency; core offerings differ.
judge_missing_evidence: The passages do not establish comparable service formats or the relative importance of franchising versus company-operated restaurants.
